blocks.text: Copying takes O(n) time and O(n) storage, sorting takes O(n log n) time with O(log n) stack, and scanning takes O(n) time. Thus time is O(n + n log n + n)=O(n log n): O(n) omits sorting, while O(n^2) is not tight for the stated sort and scan. Auxiliary space is O(n + log n)=O(n), not O(1) or O(log n), because the n-element copy dominates the sort stack. Precondition establishment and the no-mutation constraint are both part of the cost model.

feedback.reason: Sorting dominates time, and the copied array dominates auxiliary space even though the pointer scan itself is in place on that copy.
